Comprehensive experimental evaluation: three LRMs tested, multiple safety benchmarks (JailbreakBench, StrongReject, WildJailbreak), preservation of reasoning capability across diverse tasks (AIME, MATH, GPQA, HumanEval)

Stability demonstrated: ablations show robustness to detector variations, training algorithm choices, and consistent performance across hyperparameter sensitivity

Narrow scope and questionable generalization: 1,000 training prompts from single dataset, safety triggers manually curated (only 6 triggers), CSR analysis on 30 prompts, unclear adaptation to non-reasoning tasks, toxicity/bias concerns not addressed, only recent 2024-2025 models tested

Practical efficiency gains over GRPO (14 vs 40+ generations; 40 min vs 2+ hours) with consistent improvements across model sizes (1.5B to 14B)
